units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 13">Pesik. R. s. 13</cite> (v. <cite ref="R00534">preced.</cite>) <he>יושבים … הצ׳ לבוא עלי</he> they sit and look out, when I come to fall, that they may come against me.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 3:3">Midr. Till. to Ps. III</cite> (ref. to <he>בצלע</he>, <cite ref="II Samuel 16:13">II Sam. XVI, 13</cite>) <he>מזכיר לו מעשה הצ׳</he> he (Shimei) reminded him (David) of the story of the fall (David’s crime); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 151">Yalk. Sam. 151</cite>.
